order.$comment: extraction_secs 9.0 s is a placeholder, equal to the compiled default: docs/walmart-facts.md section 7 records the extraction station's operator time ('Operator time, extraction station') as unknown.

settings.$comment: The Walmart DFW6 throughput scenario, for the system's throughput with every order available at the start: order.release_all_at_start releases them all at time zero and the dataset's drop times are ignored. It runs on the bot specifications directed on 2026-09-21 (docs/walmart-facts.md section 6b), which the robot entities of walmart_dfw6.json state, and is built on walmart_dfw6_baseline_partial_spec.json. operator.time_per_pick_secs 10.0 s is section 7's 'Operator time, EasyLoop station' (compiled default 9.0 s), and the composition's PutawayInduction rate of 60 presentations an hour at each station is section 7's 'Operator time, induction station', 60 s, applied at the six decant stations; which station type that row means is still to be confirmed (compiled default 200 an hour). sim/dessim/tests/walmart_dfw6_throughput_spec.rs pins the value each figure resolves to.
